product.name: PLA Basic
product.seoMetaDescription: PLA is the most common material in 3D printing as it's easy to print and inexpensive. Meanwhile, its stiffness and strength can meet most printing needs. It is worth mentioning that it can biodegrade in some artificial composting conditions. Bambu PLA Basic is designed for high-speed printing. Compared to general PLA, it can easily achieve printing speeds up to 250-300 mm/s and has excellent toughness and Z-layer strength.

productFeaturesModuleList.title: Product Features
productFeaturesModuleList.content:
• Easy to Print & Beginner Friendly
  • Smooth Surface Finish
  • Biodegradable
  • Low indoor printing emissions, certified to UL GREENGUARD 2904

Cautions for Use

Note: The refill needs to be used with a spool.

content.title: Find the Perfect Color
content.description: With a palette of up to 30 colors, Bambu PLA Basic lets you find the perfect shade to bring flair to your projects. The colors remain consistent across prints, ensuring a stunning and uniform finish every time.

content.title: Your Worry-Free Start
content.description: Bambu PLA Basic, the easiest-to-use filament, delivers smooth printing right from the start. No complicated setups or calibrations needed. Ideal for both hobbyists and professionals seeking reliable, hassle-free results.

content.title: Built Stronger, Faster and to Last Longer
content.description:
With Bambu's exclusive fine-turned formulation based on 3D printing expertise and fine-turned settings, Bambu PLA Basic delivers stronger layer adhesion, enhanced impact resistance, and long-lasting durability compared to other standard PLA filaments on the market. Additionally, it reaches a print speed up to 258mm/s*, cutting your printing time without compromising quality.

* 0.4mm nozzle, 0.4mm line width, 0.2mm layer height

content.title: RFID for Intelligent Printing
content.description: All printing parameters are embedded in RFID, which can be read through our AMS (Automatic Material System).

content.title: UL GREENGUARD certified. Cleaner air for indoor printing.
content.description: PLA Basic is certified to UL GREENGUARD (UL 2904), the recognized standard for 3D printer emissions. The particles and VOCs released measure below the levels of an average kitchen, living room, or office—cleaner than the air you're already breathing.

answerBlocks.content: Compatible with all printers, AMS, build plate, and nozzles.
Dry before use to ensure the best print quality and consistent finish. Store in a dry environment after use. For more details, please refer to: Filament drying instructions on WIKI.
The refill filament needs to be used with a spool. For detailed instructions on how to swap in the new filament using the Bambu Reusable Spool, please refer to the guide on WIKI.

• Please store the filament in a cool, dark, and dry environment away from direct sunlight and high temperatures.
  • Please keep filament and any broken fragments out of reach of infants, children, and pets to prevent swallowing or choking.
  • For opened filament, we recommend drying before use according to the wiki’s recommended temperature and time settings.
  • Please print this filament in a well-ventilated area, or install an effective air filtration or exhaust system.
  • As this filament is not food-grade, please avoid using finished prints for food storage or contact.
